annotations.title: Look up a Georgia or U.S. constitution provision

description: One provision of the Georgia ('ga') or United States ('us') constitution as printed in the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, by citation ('Art. I, Sec. I, Para. I', 'Amend. XIV', 'Preamble') or slug, as its Markdown twin with the case annotations capped. Returns at most `max_chars` characters (default 60,000), ending with the call for the next part.

citation.description: The provision: 'Art. I, Sec. I, Para. I' (Georgia), 'Art. I, Sec. 8' or 'Amend. XIV' (United States), 'Preamble', or a slug such as art-i-sec-i-para-i.
citation.title: Citation

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

scheme.description: Which constitution: ga (the Constitution of the State of Georgia) or us (the Constitution of the United States).
scheme.title: Scheme

start.description: Where to start, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the beginning.
start.title: Start

name: constitution_lookup
title: Look up a Georgia or U.S. constitution provision
